title: Prove the sharp pooled optimum for fourth staging
body:
## Summary

- Prove that staging the fourth helper in exactly one third of calls is optimal in the pooled cost model of [PR4088](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4088), even allowing every real staging fraction and every whole-helper bin pattern.
- Certify the sharp complete-moment root in `[0.001730980255989036959962, 0.001730980255989036959963]`. The pinned literal fill has less than `1.951e-9` of possible root improvement left within this fixed two-provider invoice.
- Add an exact piecewise primal/dual proof, all 841 pattern inequalities, an integer pooled witness, source-derived local costs, and a separately implemented rational check.

## Scope and limits

The model fixes the THREE/FOUR words, 3,240 calls, 360 replicas, every original bin and residual, width 73 and stock `896*360`. It relaxes chronology, helper identity, family exclusions, offsets and pattern multiplicities. The pooled witness does not establish a legal owner fill. Changed words, capacities, operator fusions or stock require a new model.

This is a written duality/monotonicity proof backed by finite exhaustive pattern coverage and exact rational arithmetic. The larger-kappa target is not achieved; no new supplier, kappa or selected-frontier improvement is claimed. Native/dirty-state correctness, mixed-provider full release, precision, tape, BIT and outer transfer remain separate. AI specialist review is not human or formal-kernel acceptance.

All 28 exported files, including its receipt, retain bytes, modes and inodes. The portability driver/receipts are local-only orchestration; every mathematical checker is included here.
- [x] Independent AI mathematical review checks both affine regions, all three duals, complete accounting, the source's historical/current replica distinction and the global root-ceiling implication.
- [x] Natural [CI39293406364](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39293406364) completed successfully on the exact tested commit (plan and registered package replay). No workflow rerun or dispatch requested.
